verdict.rationale: Docs clearly support configuring payout frequency, currency, and timing per merchant account (adyen-docs-12, adyen-docs-30, adyen-docs-50, adyen-docs-22) and note local vs cross-border payout mechanics (adyen-docs-13, adyen-docs-43). Reporting is mentioned as giving a 'visual representation of balances, sales, and payouts' (adyen-docs-10) and the Customer Area gives an overview of payment channels (adyen-docs-16), but there is no explicit evidence of a line-item payout reconciliation report breaking down which specific charges, fees, and refunds compose each payout. Missing for 10: detailed payout reconciliation report/API showing per-payout transaction breakdown, fee itemization, and refund matching.
